statement: The learner-promotion proof-channel witness (test/convergence/dt6-learner-promotion-proof-channel-wake.test.js) is deterministic under host load: the row landing is an explicit fixture schedule — leader INSERT, wait for the leader's own replication observable (readFollowerMatchIndex at the committed prefix) to prove the learner caught up, then the learner UPDATE/wake — instead of applying both in one tick and racing liferaft's wall-clock 20 ms heartbeat against the 0 ms wake request, so two identical drives produce byte-identical refusal/wake sequences (exactly one learner_address_unresolvable refusal, two round trips, one services_row_visible wake, one kick, zero requests inside the landing phase) whether run alone or as five concurrent copies; every sealed receipt of learner-promotion-proof-channel-wake keeps its semantics and still discriminates on the reverted owner cure; only test/ and scripts/ change — the owner, liferaft timers, cadence and timeout constants are byte-identical. Proven deterministically: red on HEAD (the quantized-landing scenario and the load-robust receipt), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The cure touches only test/ and scripts/; the learner-promotion owner, liferaft timers, LEARNER_CATCH_UP_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS and MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS are byte-for-byte unchanged.

The row landing is an explicit fixture schedule ordered on the leader's own replication observable (readFollowerMatchIndex at the committed prefix), never on elapsed time; the fixture never promotes, never re-derives the proof, and never fakes an owner response.
Every sealed learner-promotion-proof-channel-wake receipt keeps its semantics and still discriminates (red on the reverted owner cure, green after); no sleeps, timeouts or bounds are widened.

Receipt commands are verbatim and self-guarding (a zero-test node --test run cannot pass as green); the sealed evidence file of the parent quest is never written by the nested harness (--output to a gitignored path).
